candidate_selection: Test the original audited 031 adapter once. Its previous constructed cohort gave a modest gain and the later historical cohort showed no net advantage. Reassessment under the frozen reference runtime measures whether it generalizes to this cohort.
conditioning: Exact 038 prefix arm. Each task gets the same one CPU-verified public failure output, normalized with 038 rules and clipped at the same boundary. Both checkpoint variants receive byte-identical initial prompts on the same task.
selection: Require two original-parent semantic failures, two passing upstream reference runs and a passing protected regrade. Choose by ascending task ID hash within each family. Verify prior training and development lineage and check mounted runtime contents for reference answers.
schedule: Hash order with repetition as salt; complete both variants on each ten-task block; alternate first variant by block and repetition.
primary_metric: Source changed, passes the protected fresh grader and explicitly submits within the actor budget.
